rules.name: Acts of Faith
rules.description:
If your Army Faction is ADEPTA SORORITAS, each unit from your army with this ability can perform one Act of Faith per phase. This is done using Miracle dice.

GAINING MIRACLE DICE
If your Army Faction is ADEPTA SORORITAS, you gain 1 Miracle dice:
- At the start of each turn.
- Each time an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army is destroyed.

Each time you gain a Miracle dice, roll one D6. The number you roll is the value of that Miracle dice. This value cannot be changed or re-rolled, unless a rule specifically states otherwise. Keep your Miracle dice to one side – this is your Miracle dice pool.

PERFORMING AN ACT OF FAITH
Before making a dice roll for a model or unit from your army with the Acts of Faith ability, if you have one or more dice in your Miracle dice pool, that unit can perform an Act of Faith. If it does, select one of the dice from your Miracle dice pool to substitute that dice roll (if a roll involves more than one dice, e.g. a Charge roll or Battle-shock test, only a single dice can be substituted). The dice that is being substituted is not rolled; instead the value of the selected Miracle dice is used as if it had been rolled (this counts as an unmodified dice roll of that value for all rules purposes). Each Miracle dice can only be selected for substitution once. Once all Miracle dice substitutions have been made, remove the chosen Miracle dice from your Miracle dice pool, and roll all remaining, unsubstituted dice that are a part of the dice roll. You can use Miracle dice when a unit performs an Act of Faith for any of the following types of dice roll:
- Advance roll
- Battle-shock test
- Charge roll
- Damage roll
- Hit roll
- Saving throw
- Wound roll

rules.name: Waaagh!
rules.description:
Friendly ORKS units with this ability can re-roll Advance rolls and can become riled up as stated in other rules.

RILED UP
While a unit is riled up:
- That unit has a 5+ invulnerable save.
- That unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
- When that unit is selected to make an Advance move, that Advance move does not prevent it from being eligible to declare a charge.

WAR CRY (Once per battle, per army)
At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh! ability are riled up until the end of the next turn.

rules.name: Da Boss
rules.description: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

rules.name: Unstable Energies
rules.description:
ORKS PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name.

In a battle round, a friendly ORKS PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit's psyker level.

rules.name: Aegis of the Emperor
rules.description: Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability have Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

rules.name: Aquila Commander
rules.description: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

rules.name: Daughters of the Abyss
rules.description:
Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units with this ability have Feel No Pain 3+ against psychic attacks.
Psychic Null (Aura): Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units within 6" of this unit have Feel No Pain 5+ against psychic attacks.

rules.name: Martial Ka'tah
rules.description:
Units with this ability become readied at the start of their Command phase. A readied unit can use one of the following Ka'tah abilities at its stated timing. After using the Ka'tah ability, the unit is no longer readied.

DACATARAI
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly readied unit. EFFECT: Its melee attacks against enemy units excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

KAPTARIS
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly readied unit. EFFECT: Melee attacks targeting your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

RENDAX
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to fight. TARGET: One friendly readied unit. EFFECT: Its melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

CONSERVAI
WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly readied unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, being engaged/battle-shocked does not prevent starting an action, and starting an action does not prevent being eligible to shoot.

CALISTUS
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to move. TARGET: That readied unit. EFFECT: When making a normal/advance/fall-back move, it can move through all types of model.

SALVUS
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That readied unit. EFFECT: It can ignore modifiers to its BS, hit rolls and wound rolls.

rules.name: Anathema Psykana
rules.description: You can include ANATHEMA PSYKANA units in your army even though they do not have the ADEPTUS CUSTODES faction keyword. Unless otherwise stated, you cannot select ANATHEMA PSYKANA as your army faction or select an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model as your WARLORD.

rules.name: Shock Disembark Move
rules.description: Maximum distance: 3". Eligible if permitted by a rule, embarked within a TRANSPORT model on the battlefield, and did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase. Set up the unit as described in Set Up (Core Rules, 03.02), with each model wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT. After moving, the unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.
